description: A benchmark-matched Commerce decision corpus combining attributed public operating references with clearly labeled synthetic demo policies. Synthetic policy PDFs apply only to the fictional Commerce Demo scenario and are not real company policy.

sources.title: Standards for Suppliers (Product Suppliers)
sources.notes: Official Walmart supplier policy. Use only as an attributed external example for supplier, product handling, and supply-chain controls; it is not policy for the synthetic Commerce Demo and does not define last-mile network decisions. PDF metadata shows modification on 2024-02-01.

sources.title: GFR Supplier Onboarding Readiness Checklist
sources.applicability: Walmart Goods For Resale supplier onboarding requirements only; Commerce Demo has no identified marketplace and this checklist is not its policy.
sources.notes: Official 13-page Walmart Goods For Resale supplier onboarding readiness checklist. It enumerates inventory-feed cadence, facility, daily capacity, delivery lead-time, carrier and dispatch inputs. Use only to inform what operations data a supplier workflow may need; do not apply Walmart eligibility or delivery requirements to Commerce Demo. The PDF is Word-generated and text-based, not a scanned document.

sources.title: Inventory Management
Campaign Performance Insights
Seller-Funded Promotions Discount Threshold Guidelines
sources.notes: Thresholds vary by promotion tool and eligible date; verify the current Seller Center before operational use.

sources.title: Delivery Policy
TikTok Shop Customer Order Shipping Guidelines
Order Fulfillment Timelines (Standard Orders)
Vietnam Platform Shipping Fee Instruction
Walmart Fulfillment Services Best Practices Checklist
sources.notes: Official Walmart Marketplace seller checklist covering inventory health, replenishment, fulfillment selection, and shipping preparation. Attribute as Walmart Marketplace guidance; applies to its marketplace, not as Commerce Demo policy.

sources.title: Product Campaigns
sources.notes: Official Vietnam Seller University procedure for registering products, campaign price and campaign stock, review, edits, and product eligibility. Applies only to TikTok Shop Vietnam.

sources.publisher: Shopee Vietnam Seller Education Hub (Shopee Uni)
sources.title: Quản lý tồn kho
sources.applicability: Historical 2019 Shopee Vietnam Seller Center guide; use only when the question explicitly concerns Shopee. It can inform SKU-level stock visibility and replenishment review, but its interface labels and thresholds are not current policy and do not apply to the unidentified Commerce Demo marketplace.
sources.notes: Official Shopee Uni Vietnam PDF with image-heavy Seller Center screenshots. Historical 2019 process reference for SKU-level stock visibility, sales-cycle review, low-stock alerts, and SKU-location records. Do not present as current policy or apply to Commerce Demo unless Shopee is explicitly in scope.

sources.publisher: Shopee Vietnam Seller Education Hub (Shopee Uni)
sources.title: Sale Sinh nhật 11.11 / 12.12: Bí quyết bán hàng và vận hành shop
sources.notes: Official Shopee Uni Vietnam campaign operations guide. Covers campaign stock, staffing and order-fulfillment risks; treat as historical company practice, not current platform policy.

sources.title: Tỷ lệ đơn hàng không thành công là gì?
sources.applicability: Shopee Vietnam seller workflows only. Publication/update date is not stated; verify current Help Center policy before using any threshold or interface instruction. Not policy for Commerce Demo.
sources.notes: Official 22-page Seller Education Hub guide describing stockout-related cancellation risk, stock accuracy, order handoff, and return handling. It contains undated thresholds and legacy Seller Center instructions, so keep out of decision retrieval until current applicability is verified. OCR Lab smoke: 22 pages, 24 chunks, 2 extracted tables, five low-text pages invoked Tesseract; screenshot text is noisy and must not support exact penalty claims.

sources.publisher: Shopee Vietnam Seller Education Hub (Shopee Uni)
sources.title: Tài liệu hướng dẫn vận hành Shop (dành cho Shopee Mall)
sources.notes: Official Shopee Uni Vietnam operating guide with seller order-processing and carrier handoff flow. Database verification on 2026-10-04 found 39 retrieval chunks despite the old manifest status; keep archived and use only as historical, attributed example, not current policy.

sources.title: Chính sách vận chuyển Shopee (phiên bản ngày 20/03/2026)
sources.notes: Current official Shopee Vietnam shipping policy page. Platform-specific constraints only; re-fetch this volatile policy before relying on its current wording or thresholds.

sources.title: How To Set Up Multi-Location Inventory Management
sources.applicability: Shopify-published workflow example only; Commerce Demo does not identify its platform.
sources.notes: Official Shopify business article describes per-location stock, transfer workflow, stockout review and routing prerequisites. Use as an attributed example, never as Commerce Demo policy or proof that the dataset has location-level inventory.

sources.title: FBA Restock Tool Guide
sources.applicability: Historical Amazon FBA restocking example only. Its Seller Central screenshots and settings are from 2020; do not transfer tool defaults, example quantities, or thresholds to Commerce Demo.
sources.notes: Official Amazon PDF guide describing restock recommendations based on product-level demand forecasts, seasonality, seller/supplier lead times, replenishment frequency, case-pack quantity, and minimum restock quantity. Use only these attributed decision inputs as an external example; not a Commerce Demo policy or evidence of the synthetic dataset's actual capabilities.

sources.title: Campaign reporting: Analyze advertising performance
sources.applicability: Amazon Ads reporting example only; Commerce Demo does not identify its ad platform.
sources.notes: Official Amazon Ads page describes campaign performance reporting, attributed sales and ROAS/measurement concepts. It helps name evidence required for budget decisions; it cannot supply missing Commerce campaign cost or a counterfactual.

sources.title: What Is a Marketing Plan? + How to Write One
sources.applicability: Shopify business-planning guidance; use as an attributed process example only, not Commerce Demo policy or evidence about its synthetic campaigns.
sources.notes: Covers planning goals, audience and channel choices, campaign budget, and tracking outcomes. It supplies a planning workflow, not a causal measurement method; use the DoorDash holdout reference for incrementality and SQL data for observed campaign outcomes.

sources.title: Smart Order Routing: How It Works in Shopify
sources.applicability: Shopify routing example only; Commerce Demo does not identify its platform.
sources.notes: Official Shopify article describes fulfillment assignment based on inventory availability, proximity, destination and split-shipment choices. Use as a checklist of missing route/location evidence, not as a recommendation to redesign this dataset’s network.

sources.title: Sam's Supplier Hub User Guide
sources.applicability: Sam's Club U.S. drop-ship supplier workflow example only. The guide is from 2022; use process concepts such as item/location inventory visibility and reviewed lead-time changes, not its interface instructions, account requirements, phone numbers, or thresholds as current Commerce Demo policy.
sources.notes: Official 48-page Sam's Club supplier guide. Relevant sections include weekly performance review (page 5), fulfillment-center/item-level lead times (pages 20-21), feed status (page 21), and low/out-of-stock review at category/item/supplier levels (pages 22-23). PDF metadata identifies Microsoft Word as creator/producer and the text layer is selectable; it is born-digital, not a scanned policy. Retain only as an attributed external process reference; it does not establish Commerce Demo's marketplace or operating rules.

sources.title: Sales Lift Measurement for CPG Brands
sources.applicability: DoorDash Ads CPG campaign measurement example only; not Commerce Demo policy. Use its experiment/holdout comparison method as an attributed reference. Do not transfer DoorDash, advertiser, or category outcomes or thresholds to Commerce Demo.
sources.notes: Official DoorDash Ads article dated 2026-03-24. Explains treatment/control measurement, holdout and ghost-ad experiment concepts for estimating incremental sales and iROAS. Relevant to the promotion benchmark's causal-lift boundary; its reported advertiser results are not Commerce Demo evidence.

sources.title: Guidelines for Incremental Measurement in Commerce Media
sources.applicability: General commerce-media measurement guidance. Attribute its methods to IAB and IAB Europe; it is not a platform rule or Commerce Demo policy, and it does not provide data about the synthetic campaigns.
sources.license: Copyright remains with IAB and IAB Europe; source is publicly downloadable. Do not redistribute the full document as a project-created work.
sources.notes: Thirteen-page industry guideline comparing experiments, modeled counterfactuals, econometrics and proxy methods. It distinguishes incremental impact from attribution/ROAS and explains test/control, bias, and measurement limitations. Relevant to the dataset because campaign spend, holdout groups, and attributed exposure data are absent; it informs what evidence is needed, not a claim that current sales lift is causal.

sources.title: Amazon Logistics Solutions: How to Choose the Right One
sources.applicability: Amazon Supply Chain Services options and network example only; not Commerce Demo policy. Attribute concepts and scope to Amazon; do not transfer Amazon service levels, network capabilities, outcomes, or performance values to the Commerce dataset.
sources.notes: Official Amazon Supply Chain Services guide. It describes how transportation, warehousing, fulfillment, parcel shipping, predictive tools, and real-time visibility fit together, including balancing cost, speed, capacity and demand. Use as an attributed decision framework; not evidence that Commerce Demo uses Amazon or any specific carrier.

sources.publisher: International Labour Organization; Employers Confederation of the Philippines
sources.title: Improve Your Business Basics: Philippine Edition, Module 3 - Stock Control
sources.published_or_updated: 2002 (repository record); scanned copy metadata dates to 2014
sources.applicability: General stock-control training for small businesses in the Philippines; dated 2002 and not Commerce Demo policy. ILO repository marks the work as copyrighted and requests reproduction permission; do not ingest or redistribute without permission.
sources.notes: Temporary OCR Lab verification on 2026-10-04: 42 pages, 76 parser chunks, no structured tables; Tesseract fallback ran on pages 1, 2, 8, 41, and 42. The scan already carries searchable text on most pages, so this is a mixed scan/OCR-layer upload test, not an OCR accuracy benchmark. The temporary OCR run was deleted and all associated rows were verified absent.

sources.title: Vendor Standard Routing Instructions (Parcel, LTL, and TL)
sources.published_or_updated: Version 2.7, updated 2024-06-18; listed in Kroger's supplier document library accessed 2026-10-08
sources.license: No reuse license stated on the publisher page; use as an attributed reference and do not redistribute the full guide.
sources.applicability: Kroger supplier routing instructions for U.S. shipments only; not Commerce Demo policy, Vietnamese routing requirements, or evidence about the synthetic Commerce dataset. Attribute every carrier, mode, threshold, and receiving rule to Kroger and do not transfer its numeric limits to Commerce Demo.
sources.notes: Ten-page official routing guide. It selects parcel, air, LTL, refrigerated LTL, or truckload using shipment weight/volume, urgency and buyer approval, destination, refrigeration, and carrier conditions; it also specifies purchase-order references and receiving constraints. Use it only as an attributed example of the operational fields a routing decision can require. The PDF contains a native text layer and tables; it is not a physical scan.

sources.title: Manage your inventory
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 Australia; exclude third-party content and logos
sources.applicability: General small-business inventory method published for Australia. Attribute as an external method, not Commerce Demo policy; do not transfer its examples or legal context as local thresholds.
sources.notes: Covers stock records, tracking, stocktakes, reorder points and inputs such as usual sales, supplier lead time, seasonality and reliability. Useful for the inventory review workflow; it cannot supply Commerce Demo's missing location, forecast or cost facts. The page is HTML, not a scanned PDF.

sources.title: Develop your marketing plan
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 Australia; exclude third-party content and logos
sources.applicability: General small-business marketing-planning method published for Australia. Attribute as an external method, not Commerce Demo policy; examples are not observed Commerce outcomes or approved thresholds.
sources.notes: Covers goals, target market, promotion/channel plan, budget and review of results. Supports planning hygiene, but it does not establish causal uplift or Commerce Demo campaign ROI. The page is HTML, not a scanned PDF.

sources.title: Shipping
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 Australia; exclude third-party content and logos
sources.applicability: General small-business e-commerce shipping selection method published for Australia. Attribute as an external method, not Commerce Demo policy; do not transfer Australian consumer-law obligations or example pricing as Vietnam rules.
sources.notes: Covers parcel-provider selection by delivery time, express availability, parcel size/weight, pickup, loss/damage terms and reporting/integration, plus shipping-cost and customer-expectation considerations. Supports provider review, not route-capacity optimization. The page is HTML, not a scanned PDF.

sources.title: Chính sách giả lập: Phân bổ và rà soát tồn kho
sources.applicability: Fictional Commerce Demo inventory scenario only. Explicitly synthetic; not an issued policy of a real retailer.
sources.notes: Trong demo, đọc cờ stockout/overstock ở mức product-snapshot; hai cờ có thể chồng lấp. Không tự đặt safety stock, reorder point, service-level target hoặc ngưỡng. Chỉ cân nhắc điều chuyển sau khi đối chiếu SKU gửi/nhận, tồn khả dụng, nhu cầu dự báo, lead time, chi phí và ràng buộc dịch vụ; thay đổi đặt hàng còn cần lịch sử nhu cầu, quy cách đặt hàng, chi phí lưu kho và mục tiêu dịch vụ đã được phê duyệt.
sources.notes_en: For this demo, stockout and overstock flags are product-snapshot indicators and may overlap. Do not invent safety stock, reorder point, service-level targets, or thresholds. Consider a transfer only after matching source and destination SKU, available stock, forecast demand, lead time, cost, and service constraints. Order changes also require demand history, order constraints, carrying cost, and an approved service target.

sources.title: Chính sách giả lập: Đánh giá và lập kế hoạch khuyến mãi
sources.applicability: Fictional Commerce Demo promotion scenario only. Explicitly synthetic; not an issued policy of a real retailer.
sources.notes: Quy tắc giả lập chỉ áp dụng trong demo: tách kết quả quan sát khỏi tác động tăng thêm và lợi nhuận. Không tự đặt ngưỡng ROI hoặc uplift; cần nhóm đối chứng cùng bằng chứng chi phí và biên lợi nhuận theo chiến dịch trước khi tăng ngân sách.
sources.notes_en: Demo rule only: separate observed outcomes from incrementality and profitability. Do not invent ROI or uplift thresholds; require a control or holdout plus campaign cost and margin evidence before increasing budget.

sources.title: Chính sách giả lập: Theo dõi và tối ưu logistics toàn quốc
sources.applicability: Fictional Commerce Demo logistics scenario only. Explicitly synthetic; not an issued policy of a real retailer.
sources.notes: Quy tắc giả lập chỉ áp dụng trong demo: so sánh logistics theo vùng ở mức mô tả và yêu cầu bằng chứng trước khi thiết kế lại mạng lưới. Không tự đặt ngưỡng SLA hoặc tiết kiệm; cần dữ liệu tuyến, hãng vận chuyển, SLA, năng lực và chi phí.
sources.notes_en: Demo-only rule: compare regional logistics descriptively and require evidence before redesigning the network. Do not invent SLA or savings thresholds; obtain route, carrier, SLA, capacity, and cost data.

sources.title: [Mô hình FBT] Hướng dẫn theo dõi báo cáo tồn kho
sources.applicability: Tiki Fulfillment by Tiki (FBT) sellers only. Treat age bands, fees, screens, and workflows as Tiki-specific; they are not Commerce Demo policy or thresholds. Use the report fields as an attributed example of evidence needed for SKU-, warehouse-, status-, and age-aware inventory review.
sources.notes: Official Tiki Seller Academy workflow for physical stock, in-process stock, stock by fulfillment warehouse, period movement reconciliation, inventory aging, and estimated storage cost. It describes how Tiki FBT sellers inspect and export reports. Tiki-specific fee bands and fulfillment states must not be transferred to Commerce Demo.

sources.title: Hướng dẫn đăng ký và quản lý chương trình Deal ngành hàng (Category Deal)
sources.applicability: Tiki Category Deal workflow only. Eligibility rules, campaign overlap handling, platform allocation, suggested prices/quantities, and campaign priority are Tiki-specific and must not be applied as Commerce Demo policy or generic thresholds.
sources.notes: Official Tiki Seller Academy steps for choosing eligible products, checking overlapping campaign windows, setting campaign price/quantity/order limits, monitoring low-stock warnings, allocation/rejection, and reviewing campaign units and revenue. Useful as an attributed campaign-control example; it does not establish incremental lift or profitability.

sources.title: [Mô hình FBT] Hướng dẫn luân chuyển hàng hóa lưu kho Tiki
sources.applicability: Tiki FBT stock transfers among Tiki fulfillment warehouses only. Tiki warehouse names, eligibility rules, fee formulas, and workflows are platform-specific; they are not routes, carrier costs, or policy for Commerce Demo.
sources.notes: Official Tiki Seller Academy guide to requesting stock movement between Tiki FBT warehouses. It requires an identified source warehouse, destination warehouse, SKU, quantity, eligibility, and route-dependent transfer cost. This illustrates the evidence required before evaluating a transfer; it does not prove a transfer is beneficial for Commerce Demo.

ocr_demo.note: Two-page image-only synthetic fixture with visible warnings; use only in Upload Test, never index as company policy or decision evidence.
